validation.siteNotFound: No active site with this name. Add the site first, or check the spelling.
validation.siteAmbiguous: More than one client has a site with this name. Fill in the Client column too.
validation.duplicateInFile: This appears more than once in the file.
validation.invalidQuantity: Enter a quantity above 0, for example 1, 26 or 7.5.
validation.tooManyLines: Too many items. Split them into two documents.
validation.dueBeforeIssue: This date must be on or after the document date.
validation.paymentTooLarge: This is more than the balance due. Check the amount.

validation.refundTooLarge: This is more than the amount owed to the client.
validation.invalidDays: Enter the number of days, for example 2 or 0.5. It cannot be more than the days in the month.
validation.invalidHours: Enter hours, for example 10 or 7.5 (at most 300 in a month).
validation.netNegative: Deductions are more than the salary. Lower the advance or deductions (carry the rest to next month).
validation.timesheetWorkerUnknown: Worker not found. Keep the 'Worker ref' column from the template, or add the worker under Workforce first.
validation.timesheetWorkerAmbiguous: Two workers have this name. Use the template so each row has its worker ref.
validation.timesheetWorkerArchived: This worker is archived. Restore them under Workforce, or remove the row.
validation.timesheetWorkerTwice: This worker appears twice in the file. Keep one row.
validation.timesheetWorkerOnOtherSheet: This worker is already on another salary sheet for this month.

salaries.body: Download the Excel template, fill hours, upload. Overtime, allowances and deductions are calculated; approve and print payslips.

finance.title: Income and expenses
finance.body: Invoice payments become income and approved salaries become expenses automatically. See profit for each site.

dashboard.title: One clear dashboard
dashboard.body: Expiring documents, money to collect, unpaid salaries and this month's income against expenses, at a glance.

excel.title: Excel in, Excel out
excel.body: Import clients, sites and workers from Excel. Export your data at any time, even after your plan ends.

steps.title: Up and running in one afternoon

one.title: Add your company
one.body: Name, logo, VAT and CR number. Used on every invoice.

two.title: Add clients, sites and workers
two.body: Type them in or import your existing Excel sheets.

three.title: Invoice and pay salaries
three.body: Send your first tax invoice in under a minute and run this month's salaries.

pricing.title: Simple prices in Saudi riyals
pricing.subtitle: Every plan has every feature. Pick by the size of your workforce. Pay yearly and get 2 months free.
pricing.trialNote: Start with a 7-day free trial. No card needed. Choose a plan only when you are ready.
pricing.draft: Introductory prices, subject to change before launch.

trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: You get 7 days with every feature. No card is needed. One free trial per email address and mobile number.

after.q: What happens when the trial or my plan ends?
after.a: Your company becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted: you can still open and export everything. Choose a plan and you can work again straight away.

zatca.a: Tax invoices include the seller and buyer details, VAT number, date and time, VAT breakdown and the Phase 1 (generation phase) QR code. Phase 2 integration with the Fatoora platform is planned; please check which phase applies to your business on the ZATCA website.

arabic.q: Can I use it in Arabic?
arabic.a: Yes. The whole app, invoices, payslips and PDFs work in Arabic and English. Every user picks their own language.

payment.a: Online with mada, Visa, Mastercard or Apple Pay. You receive a tax invoice right after paying. There are no automatic charges: we remind you 7 days and 1 day before your plan ends.

data.a: {location}. Iqama and passport numbers are encrypted and hidden in lists. Only people you invite can see your company.

change.a: Yes. Pick another plan or billing cycle when you renew; it starts when your current paid period ends. Need more room right away? Message us on WhatsApp.

team.q: Can my accountant use it too?
team.a: Yes. Invite your accountant. Accountants work with invoices, workers, salaries and finance; billing and company settings stay with the owner.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.body: Questions about your company's setup or prices? Message us on WhatsApp and a real person will answer, in Arabic or English.

cta.title: Try it with your own data this week
cta.body: Seven days free, no card. If it is not for you, simply stop.
